data.long_description:
Experience luxury family living at its finest with this stunning 5-bedroom villa for rent in Meadows 9, Dubai. Nestled in one of Emirates Living’s most sought-after communities, this beautifully maintained property offers an ideal combination of elegance, comfort, and tranquility, perfect for modern family life.

The villa features a spacious layout with bright, open-plan living and dining areas that seamlessly connect to a private garden, creating the perfect setting for entertaining or relaxing. The five generously sized bedrooms include built-in wardrobes, while the master suite boasts a walk-in closet, a private balcony with beautiful community views, and an en-suite bathroom designed with premium finishes.

Company Name: Provident Real Estate
RERA ORN: 1933
